app_summary: Dub a video into another language, with subtitles in both languages
app_description: The RuscaLinux dubbing room: from a video in its own language it makes subtitles in both languages, the dubbed audio and a video with both audio tracks and both subtitle tracks. It transcribes with ruscawhisper-engine, translates and dubs with ruscallama-engine, and mixes with FFmpeg. Nothing leaves the machine.
ai_note: Design, specifications and testing by the author; code written with the assistance of AI tools.
discard_body: The dubbing is still running: if you close, it stops and the work done so far is lost.
guide_missing: The user guide is not installed.
log_empty: The engines have not written anything yet.
empty_desc: Choose a video or drop it here: RuscaDubbing transcribes its speech, translates it and has a voice say it in the language you choose.
source_language_sub: The language spoken in the video; “Automatic” detects it
source_language_srt: The language of the chosen subtitle file
target_language_sub: The languages the voice can speak
srt_needs_video: Choose a video first, then its subtitles.
out_srt_sub: SRT files in the original language, in the dubbing language and in both together
out_audio_sub: The dubbed track on its own, as Opus
out_video_sub: The original picture, the original and the dubbed audio, subtitles in both languages
ducking_sub: How much it is lowered while the dubbed voice speaks
stage_translate_sub: The language model fits each line to its time
stage_dub_sub: The voice says each line at its time
stage_mix_sub: FFmpeg puts together audio, subtitles and picture
same_language: The dubbing language is the original one: the lines are not translated.
done_kept: {n} lines the model did not translate were kept in the original language.
partial_files: The files already made ({n}) were kept in the folder.
models_hint: RuscaDubbing uses the models of RuscaTranscriber, RuscaTranslator and RuscaNarrator: copy them into their folders.
voice_hint: With a reference voice every line has the same voice. You can make one with “Create a Voice” in RuscaNarrator.
max_speed_sub: How much a line that does not fit in its time can be sped up
seed_sub: The same seed gives the same performance
gpu_sub: Much faster; turn off if the driver gives problems
threads_sub: This computer has {n} physical cores: use as many
context_sub: Tokens the language model keeps in memory; 8192 are enough
banner_no_llm_engine: ruscallama-engine is not installed: it is needed to translate and dub.
banner_no_whisper_engine: ruscawhisper-engine is not installed: it is needed to transcribe the video.
banner_no_whisper_model: A Whisper model for transcription is missing.
banner_no_llm_model: A language model for translation is missing.
banner_no_voice_model: A speech synthesis model for dubbing is missing.
err_no_ffmpeg: FFmpeg is not installed: it is needed to read and write videos.
err_not_video: The file is not a video
err_no_speech: There is no speech to dub in the video
err_audio: Could not read or process the audio
err_engine: An engine stopped with an error
err_empty: There is no text to speak
err_mux_mp4: Could not write the MP4 video: try the MKV format, which accepts every kind of picture
err_no_audio_srt_body: There is no speech to transcribe: choose an SRT file with the original subtitles.
err_srt_language: What Language Are the Subtitles In?
err_srt_language_body: With an SRT file, choose the original language: it cannot be detected from the text.
find_voice_tip: Voices in the dubbing language that resemble the original one
finder_hint: The original voice is only measured: the model never hears or copies it. The new voices are invented, in the dubbing language.
finder_voices_desc: Most similar first. Listen to them and keep the one you like best.
finder_name_body: The voice is saved among the RuscaNarrator voices and becomes the reference voice of the dubbing.
err_no_voice: There is not enough voice to measure
llm_device_sub: The language model: the one with more memory, if the model is large
tts_device_sub: Qwen3-TTS, also for “Find a Similar Voice”
done_fast: {n} translated subtitles are faster than comfortable reading (17 characters per second): consider shortening them by hand.
saved_forget_tip: Delete the saved transcription and translations: the next dubbing redoes them
preview_tip: Dub only the first minute, to try voice and settings
done_reused_all: Transcription and translation taken from the saved work: only voice and mixing were redone.
done_reused_some: Part of the work was taken from the saved work.
stage_refit: Shortening the sentences too long to speak…
done_refit: {n} sentences too long to speak were shortened and spoken again.
